name: Baek Jong-yeol
bio: Baek Jong-yeol (백종열), known professionally as Baik, is a South Korean film director.

credits.title: Reawakened Man
credits.overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed.

credits.title: Believer 2
credits.overview: A determined detective continues his search for the truth behind Asia's largest drug organization and its elusive boss he has unfinished business with.

credits.title: The Beauty Inside
credits.overview: Woo-jin, a furniture designer who wakes up in a different body every day, falls for Yi-soo, a woman he meets through his work.
